argv: [Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; $a=Get-NetAdapter | Where-Object {$_.InterfaceDescription -like "*Realtek*"}; [pscustomobject]@{Adapters=@($a|Select-Object Name,InterfaceDescription,Status,MacAddress,LinkSpeed,InterfaceIndex); Addresses=@(Get-NetIPAddress -AddressFamily IPv4|Where-Object {$_.InterfaceIndex -in @($a.InterfaceIndex)}|Select-Object InterfaceAlias,InterfaceIndex,IPAddress,PrefixLength); Neighbors=@(Get-NetNeighbor -AddressFamily IPv4|Where-Object {$_.InterfaceIndex -in @($a.InterfaceIndex) -and $_.State -ne "Unreachable"}|Select-Object InterfaceIndex,IPAddress,LinkLayerAddress,State); ProxyTunnel=@(Get-NetAdapter|Where-Object {$_.InterfaceDescription -match "Tunnel"}|Select-Object Name,Status); AutoShop=@(Get-Process AutoShop -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|Select-Object Id,MainWindowTitle,Path)}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
